Term sheet: class fund $55,000,000; attorneys' fees $12,500,000; clear sailing yes; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
Term sheet: class fund $35,000,000; attorneys' fees $7,000,000; clear sailing yes; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
A $35 million automatic class fund preserves the latest requested class relief; reducing fees to $5 million brings the total to the authorized ceiling.
The $5 million fee is above the firm's $3.5 million investment
fees sufficient to cover the firm's investment

summary: Plaintiffs first introduced fee terms in their opening proposals, and fee amounts plus clear-sailing terms were negotiated before any final class settlement was accepted. The transcript expressly links fee reductions to preserving the $35 million class fund within Brightline’s all-in cap, and class counsel privately considered their own fee economics. The record does not clearly show class counsel sacrificing class recovery for fees, defense leveraging fee interests to reduce recovery, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading court declaration.
